products.name: Ornament Christmas tree
products.description:
Handmade Wooden Christmas Tree with Hanging Ornament

Bring the warmth and charm of the holiday season into your home with this handcrafted wooden Christmas tree from JDB Woodworks!

Designed to add a festive touch to any space, each tree features a simple yet eye-catching design and a hanging Christmas ornament that adds the perfect finishing touch.

Available in three classic Christmas colors:

* Red
* Green
* White

Whether displayed on a mantel, tabletop, shelf, or as part of your holiday centerpiece, these wooden Christmas trees make a wonderful addition to your seasonal decorations.

Handcrafted with care, designed to bring Christmas cheer, and made to be enjoyed for many holiday seasons to come!

🎄 Add a little handmade Christmas magic to your home with JDB Woodworks!
